english.title: Omit information from a notification to housing authority on change of occupation or ownership
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) having given a notification to the local housing authority, namely **(..SPECIFY AUTHORITY..), as required by section 247 of the Housing Act 1985, knowingly or recklessly omitted information required, in that **(..SPECIFY OMISSION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 249(1)(d) of the Housing Act 1985.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
knowingly or recklessly
omitted from a notification under section 247 of the Housing Act 1985
any information required to be contained in it by virtue of any provision of section 248

english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) having given a notification to the local housing authority, namely **(..SPECIFY AUTHORITY..), as required by section 247 of the Housing Act 1985, the defendant knowingly or recklessly omitted information required, in that **(..SPECIFY OMISSION..).

other.penalty:
Summary: a fine not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

Note
On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
